title: The Big Meeting
content:
Emma was the owner of a small coffee company. Her business was growing, and she wanted to open a new store.

On Monday morning, she had an important meeting with her team.

“We need to plan everything carefully,” Emma said.

She looked at her manager.

“How many employees do we need for the new store?”

“I think we need ten employees,” he replied.

Emma wrote the number in her notebook.

Then she asked another question.

“How much money do we need to open the store?”

The manager looked at the report.

“We need about fifty thousand dollars.”

Emma was very surprised.

“That is very expensive!”

Her marketing manager joined the conversation.

“We also need to think about our products.”

Emma nodded.

“How many products are we going to sell?”

“About twenty different products,” the manager answered.

“And how much coffee do we need every month?”

“At least five hundred kilograms,” he said.

Emma looked at everyone.

“This is a very important project,” she said. “We need to work very carefully.”

After the meeting, the team started preparing everything.

They ordered furniture, created advertisements, and interviewed new employees.

Three months later, the new coffee store opened.

On the first day, many customers arrived.

Emma looked at the long line and smiled.

The project was difficult and very expensive.

But it was also very successful.

Emma looked at her team and asked one final question:

“How many more stores can we open?”

Everyone laughed.

The business was growing faster than they expected.
